title: Package report
description: POST /api/v1/reports/packages (FR-2.3, P2-S08). Every installed package from the host's package manager. The body may be sent with `Content-Encoding: gzip`. A host whose package manager is not supported says so with `manager: unsupported` and a reason, and sends no packages, so it is never mistaken for a host with none installed.

schema_version.description: Payload schema version. This directory is version 1.

report_id.description: UUIDv4, generated per report and reused on retry so the server can discard duplicates.

collected_at.description: When the agent collected the facts (agent clock), RFC 3339 UTC.

manager.description: The package manager the agent found. `dpkg` is the only supported one (DEC-01); `unsupported` when the host has another or none.

unsupported_reason.description: Why the packages could not be listed, for the operator, when `manager` is `unsupported`; `null` otherwise.

packages.description: Every installed package, in any order; empty when `manager` is `unsupported`. A name and architecture appear at most once.

version.description: Installed version exactly as the package manager records it, with any epoch, for example `1:3.5.1-1+deb13u1`. Compared with dpkg's rules, never as a string (FR-2.4).

source.description: Source package name, which vulnerability data is keyed on (DEC-11); `null` when the package manager records none.

warnings.description: Problems reading the package list, for the operator. The packages that were read are still sent.

field.description: What could not be read in full.
